relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings indicated that pregabalin could relieve neuropathic pain to a certain extent by suppressing the PKCε/TRPV1 signaling pathway and inhibiting inflammatory processes in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: PKCε
relationships.evidence_quote: we aimed to investigate whether PKC epsilon (PKCε)/ transient receptor potential vanilloid subtype 1(TRPV1) signaling pathway participated in pregabalin-induced analgesia

key_findings: Pregabalin alleviates SNI neuropathic pain in rats while suppressing spinal PKCε/TRPV1 signaling and inflammation.
